desc: A robotic arm reaches into a paper bag and pulls out containers of food onto a table while Raj, Leonard, and Sheldon cheer.
The robotic hand drops the small package into Penny's hand, which she held out expectantly.
The robotic hand holds up two fingers in front of Sheldon.
Leonard grabs a blue napkin from the robotic hand and sits down in a chair.
Penny spits water out and the robot hands penny a blue napkin.
Sheldon, in a yellow shirt with grey sleeves, knocks on Penny's door repeatedly.
Penny, in a pink patterned tank top, opens her mouth wide in shock, moving her head to the side, at Sheldon.
Howard, in a green shirt, slowly turns his head around and looks at the robot hand massaging his shoulder.
The hand of a robot massages Howard's shoulder, while he opens his mouth wide and closes his eyes in pleasure.
Penny, while driving a car, briefly turns toward Sheldon, the corner of her mouth lifting into a smile.
Leonard, while talking to Raj, reaches his hand toward the magazines on the table and holds his hand on them for a moment.
Leonard reaches for Howard's laptop on the bed, but Howard, under the purple blanket, stops him with a gesture.
Raj does a pulling gesture with both hands as he stands beside Leonard, who has his arms crossed.
Howard is sitting in his bed with a purple blanket over his private parts and rubs his eyes with his hands.
Sheldon, in a yellow shirt with grey sleeves, raises his head from a plate with a strange expression while smiling in a restaurant.
Penny raises her shoulders and body, mouth open and eyes closed, sitting next to Sheldon, in a yellow shirt, at the restaurant.
Penny puts her head down on her hand at the restaurant table.
Penny points to their table for the waiter at the restaurant, while sitting with Amy and Sheldon.
Leonard and Raj slowly walk through a doorway into a clinic pulling a robotic arm that is attached, underneath a blanket, to Howard.
The nurse takes off her glasses and walks over and looks underneath the Howard's purple blanket.
The nurse walks over to the desk and picks up the phone receiver and talks to it.
The nurse is speaking to Howard, while Raj and Leonard look at each other beside her and laugh.
The nurse click something on laptop that Leonard is holding and Howard's robotic arm releases him.
Penny, at the door, looks angry at Sheldon, wearing a yellow shirt and grey sleeves, then he smiles and opens the door to his apartment.
Sheldon, wearing a yellow shirt and grey sleeves, enters the apartment while Leonard talks on his cell phone.
Howard is screaming in shock, then looks under the purple blanket around his hips and smiles, at the clinic.
Sheldon, in a yellow shirt, raises his hand in a stop gesture while in a car with Amy in the back seat and Penny driving.
Howard is sitting in his bed with a purple blanket over his private parts and shaking his spread arms in panic.
Amy's expressionless face suddenly shifts into a smug, close-lipped smile at the restaurant table.
People in the clinic waiting room suddenly look at Howard, a robotic arm attached under his blanket, after a nurse speaks on the phone.
